caption: Each worker runs 50 tasks of 4 min (200 min) and pays 25 min of scheduling overhead, so the run ends at 225 min — the ideal 200 min is never reached. Throughput is 600 ÷ 225 ≈ 2.67 tasks/min, about 160 tasks an hour.

spec.aria: Gantt chart of the 600-task example: lanes W1, W2, W3 and the combined row for all 12 workers each show 200 minutes of task work (50 tasks of 4 minutes) followed by 25 minutes of scheduling overhead (50 × 0.5 minutes), so every lane ends at 225 minutes instead of the ideal 200.
